By: Internal | Paid

Proposal


Show: Carte Blanche

One Liner (Tonight on Carte Blanche...):
We reconnect with Grace, a netball coach whose inspiring story captivated the hearts of many viewers when we featured it on our show.

Unique Selling Point:
The strength of unity: Following the July 9th broadcast, an overwhelming surge of donations poured in to support Grace's netball team. Additionally, Grace herself has been honored with an award.

Summary:
Story Update: Since the triumphant conclusion of the netball world cup hosted on our home turf, women's sports have taken center stage. On July 9th, we shared the story of Grace, a dedicated netball team coach. Today, we reconnect with her to explore the transformations that have unfolded since our initial broadcast.

Script:


VO: Brave, Tenacious… an unsung hero.

Netball coach Grace Mokoto is changing the lives of young girls in her community in the North West.

Cutaway: Grace archive 09 July Broadcast Footage
05:07 – 05:11

UPSOUND: 01:24 – 01:32
They are my happiness. I know these kids have talent. When I am with the kids I am happy. I love being surrounded by them.
VO: In July this year, our story revealed the unique challenges of running a netball club in a troubled community.

Ravaged by unemployment and teen pregnancy, Grace’s club has been a refuge for many young girls.

But it hasn’t been easy.
UPSOUND: Grace

Grace Archive:
Grace - we don’t have sports facilities. we don’t have equipment. transport money, food money, also the attire. When they are wearing a kit, they have the confidence, they can play, but when she is wearing whatever, she doesn't have the confidence.
VO: And despite all these challenges Grace & her netball team remains sanguine.


UPSOUND: Keamogetse & Matshidiso
Keamogetse – She’s a great couch and she’s very determined to keep us playing. She make’s plan for us even when we are struggling.

Matshidiso – A lot of people out there don’t think sport is important, But for me I think it is important because it keeps you from lot of bad things like teenage pregnancy like drinking. It a good thing to keep away from bad things.


VO: Since our broadcast, viewers have stepped up to lend a helping hand to Grace and her team.
Grace Archive Cutaway UPSOUND

Grace: 03:20 – 03:40
The story is really helping me a lot, Up to so far I have received donations from different people.. and some have promised that they are going to donate kit. I think the story is really helping. I believe that I am going to get some funding or sponsors

VO: Grace received an overwhelming show of support, with numerous donations from our viewers and a R10 000 cheque from South African Local Government Association. Picture of the cheque

UPSOUND: Grace Picture of children watching TV as layover Yooo… The players were really happy. The were so excited, Singing and dancing Even after watching the story on TV. They cleaned my house just to say thank you couch. You really doing a lot for us.

VO: Grace wants more people in her community to join her initiative.

UPSOUND Grace: 07:29 – 07:37
I can’t do this alone. I need people to help me so that we can run this properly.
